indexed_dirs.description: List of directory paths to index (space-separated in config); supports recursion if configured externally.

file_extensions.description: List of file extensions to include in indexing (without dots, space-separated).

case_sensitive.description: If true, search is case-sensitive; if false, case-insensitive (uses IgnoreCase).

max_word_length.description: Maximum length (in characters) of words to store in the index. Set to 0 for no limit.

min_word_length.description: Shortest word length to index (shorter words are ignored).

stemming.description: Stemming algorithm to apply to words (e.g., 'none', 'porter', 'snowball').

stopwords_file.description: Path to a file containing stop words (one per line). Leave empty to disable stop-word filtering.

meta_config_file.description: Path to a file defining meta tag parsing rules (e.g., for extracting custom metadata from HTML).

index_number.description: Numeric index slot (1–20). Must be unique per field.

meta_fields.description: List of metadata fields to extract and index. Each field maps a name to an index number.

index_file.description: File path where the compiled search index will be stored.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for indexing events. Empty string means log to stderr.

rotate_index_files.description: Number of documents to index before rotating (creating new) index files. Set to 0 to disable.

max_index_file_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) per index file before rotation. 0 disables size-based rotation.

description_field.description: Metadata field to use as the default description when displaying results (e.g., 'title', 'abstract').

index_name.description: Name for this index (used in multi-index environments for identification).

header_config_file.description: Path to a file defining header parsing rules (for HTTP or document headers).

default_description.description: Fallback description text used when a document lacks the configured description field.

parallel_workers.description: Number of parallel processes to use for indexing (0 = single-process mode).
